@lurexa/auth.role: Legacy session/context scaffold. Canonical product authentication is implemented through current app/Core boundaries; do not add new runtime consumers.

@lurexa/backend.role: Shared implementation package. Root barrel is browser-safe; privileged capabilities must be imported through explicit server-only subpaths.

@lurexa/config.role: Shared product/domain/configuration contracts that must remain runtime-neutral.

@lurexa/database.role: Legacy generic database abstraction/scaffold. Core persistence is implemented by governed backend repositories; do not add new runtime consumers.

@lurexa/sdk.role: Typed cross-product/client contract helpers. It must not own authoritative persistence or privileged mutations.

@lurexa/tokens.role: Canonical design-token contract shared across product personalities.

@lurexa/types.role: Canonical shared TypeScript contracts and domain types.

@lurexa/ui.role: Shared browser-safe UI grammar and primitives.
